title: 제가 먼저 끊겠습니다
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and ninth chords. A fretless bass guitar performs melodic slides and sixteenth-note fills. Digital synthesizers provide bright, bell-like pads and staccato brass-style stabs. The drum kit features a gated reverb snare and a crisp hi-hat playing sixteenth-note patterns. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor with occasional falsetto transitions. Key of E Major. Tempo is 105 BPM.
